items.name: Nyresoleier
items.observations: This representative watercolor of the Ranunculus auricomus aggregate shows long-petioled kidney-shaped to rounded scalloped basal leaves, upper stem leaves finely divided into narrow segments, branching green stems, bright yellow blossoms with variably reduced petals, green upright sepals, yellow stamens, and a basal root crown. The group is a complex of numerous mainly apomictic microspecies and the image does not depict any one taxon as diagnostically certain.
items.limitations: This is not a species diagnosis. The artwork includes a more regular flower with more petals than can commonly be seen in some members; other flowers show reduced petals. Shape and depth of basal leaf lobing vary across different members and time points. Exact microspecies identity requires careful study of populations and growth stages; the illustration serves as a representative group-level field guide only.
